name: Group Membership Request
description: Allows users to request access to Groups
project_description:
Synopsis 
 Group Membership Request module extends Group module. It allows users to request a membership to a group and managers (administrators) to approve these requests.

 Requirements 
 
 Group 
 State machine 
 
 Group request Membership 2.0 
 This version is based on Group 2.0, which provides upgrade path.

GroupContentEnabler plugin was replace with GroupRelationship plugin.

The rest of the module works as before.

It is the first step for migration to Group 3.0.

 Group request Membership 3.0 
 This version is based on Group 3.0.
